messages.subject: Maple Court - CQC inspection, urgent help needed
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

We had a CQC responsive inspection at our Maple Court home in Colchester last week and the verbal feedback was bad - they're talking about an 'Inadequate' rating on safe and well-led, and a likely warning notice on medicines. There was a medication omission for a resident who was then hospitalised, and a safeguarding referral is open with Essex.

Can you act for us? We need advice on the warning notice, the factual accuracy process and what comes next. I can send the inspection feedback notes.

Daniel

Daniel Pryce
General Counsel & Company Secretary
Ashbourne Healthcare Group Limited

messages.subject: RE: Maple Court - CQC inspection, urgent help needed
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel,

Yes, we can act and will move quickly. Tom Gallagher will handle day-to-day with me supervising. I attach our engagement letter setting out scope and our team - if you can countersign we'll get going today.

In the meantime: please preserve the MAR charts, the medicines audit records, the rota and the safeguarding/notification correspondence. Do not share any internal review or our advice externally without speaking to us first - but keep your duty of candour communications with the family going; that is important and we are not asking you to pause those.

We should expect (i) a warning notice on Regulation 12, (ii) a draft report for factual accuracy comments, and likely (iii) a notice of proposal to impose conditions. I'll set out strategy in a note shortly.

Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP

T +44 (0)20 7946 0500
